blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) jointly process visual and textual representations throughout generation.
These models repeatedly update the text tokens through multimodal attention, forming dynamic contextual tokens whose function is not well understood.
In this work, we introduce a framework for reading this contextual space through natural-language interrogation. We train a lightweight bottleneck network that maps intermediate contextual tokens into the input space of a frozen Large Language Model (LLM), allowing the LLM to answer questions about the emerging image directly from these hidden representations. Our reader reveals that contextual tokens encode a rich, global representation of the emerging scene:
generation-specific semantics, including attributes left underspecified by the prompt, are accessible surprisingly early in denoising, while increasingly fine-grained details become readable over time.
Remarkably, this information remains decodable even when
the MM-DiT receives an empty prompt,
showing that contextual tokens accumulate substantial image-specific information from the evolving visual representation itself. We further find that
generations with more readable contextual representations tend to receive higher human-preference scores.
Building on
these observations, we introduce Contextual Alignment,
a training technique that explicitly reinforces the visual-semantic information encoded in the contextual tokens, improving generation quality and distributional coverage.
Together, our results establish contextual tokens as both an interpretable view into the internal dynamics of MM-DiTs and an effective target for improving generative models.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
In recent years, diffusion models have fundamentally transformed visual content creation by enabling high-fidelity generation directly from text prompts ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ; Ramesh et al., 2022 ) . Building on this foundation, Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) have emerged as a dominant paradigm for state-of-the-art image and video synthesis ( Esser et al., 2024 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Chefer et al., 2026 ) . Central to these models are multimodal attention layers, which
enable bidirectional interaction between textual and visual representations throughout generation.
blocks.zh:
近年来,传播模式通过直接从文字提示中实现高真能生成,从根本上改变了视觉内容的创造(Rombach等,2022;Saharia等,2022;Ramesh等,2022)。 在这个基础上,多模式扩散变形器(MM-DITs)成为了最先进的图像和视频合成的主导范例(Esser等,2024;Kong等,2024;Chefer等,2026)。 这些模型的核心是多模式关注层,即:
使文字和视觉表现之间能够进行双向互动。

blocks.en:
Within this shared multimodal space, visual tokens form a spatial representation of the evolving image and are explicitly supervised by the denoising objective.
Their intermediate features can therefore be directly visualized as images ( Patashnik et al., 2023 ; Tumanyan et al., 2023 ) , making them especially accessible to analysis and intervention. This has enabled methods that guide visual features for controlled generation ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Chefer et al., 2023 ) , manipulate them for image editing ( Meng et al., 2021 ; Avrahami et al., 2022 ; Hertz et al., 2022 ) , and align them with pretrained representations to improve generation ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Leng et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
在这个共享的多模式空间中,视觉符号构成不断演变的图像的空间代表,并受到去名目标的明确监督.
因此,它们的中间特征可以直接被可视化为图像(Patashnik等,2023;Tumanyan等,2023),使其特别便于分析和干预. 这使得能够引导可控生成的视觉特征的方法(Ho and Salimans, 2022;Zhang等人, 2023;Cefer等人, 2023)被操纵用于图像编辑(Meng等人, 2021; Avrahami等人, 2022; Hertz等人, 2022),并与经过预先培训的表达方法相配合来改善生成(Yu等人, 2024;Leng等人, 2025;Jiang等人, 2025).

blocks.en: The text stream, however, is considerably less understood. In modern MM-DiTs, text tokens do not remain fixed conditioning vectors. Instead, they are repeatedly updated through multimodal attention, absorbing information from the emerging visual representation and evolving into what prior work termed contextual tokens ( Dahary et al., 2026 ) . Although this cross-modal exchange has proven effective for generation ( Esser et al., 2024 ) , the function of the resulting contextual representations remains unclear. Unlike visual tokens, contextual tokens have no explicit spatial correspondence and receive no dedicated supervision, making them inherently difficult to interpret. Consequently, it remains unknown what visual information they encode and how their dynamics ultimately steer the generation process.
blocks.zh: 然而,对文本流的理解要少得多。 在现代的MM-DiTs中,文本符号并不仍然是固定的调值向量. 相反,它们通过多模式的注意而不断得到更新,吸收了新兴视觉表现的信息,并演变为先前的工作所说的背景标志(Dahary等,2026年)。 虽然这种跨模式的交流已证明对一代人有效(Esser等,2024年),但由此产生的背景表述的功能仍不明确。 与视觉标志不同的是,上下文标志没有明确的空间通信,也没有接受专门的监督,使其在本质上难以被解释. 因此,他们编码的视觉信息以及他们的动态如何最终引导生成过程仍然不明了。

blocks.en: In this work, we propose a framework to directly read and interpret the contextual space of MM-DiTs by enabling natural language interrogation of their hidden representations. Rather than inspecting raw attention maps or feature vectors, our approach enables asking plain-text questions about visual elements in the emerging image and receiving direct answers decoded straight from the contextual tokens. To achieve this, we train a lightweight bottleneck network that projects intermediate contextual tokens into the input space of a Large Language Model (LLM). Because the LLM relies exclusively on the projected contextual tokens to answer visual questions, the bottleneck learns to extract the model’s internal visual semantics directly from the text-side representation. In doing so, we can read the model’s evolving generative intent in plain text, revealing how it internally resolves underspecified prompt attributes over the course of generation.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出一个框架,通过允许对MM-DIT的隐藏表述进行自然语言的询问,直接解读和解释其背景空间. 我们的方法不是检查原始的注意地图或特征向量,而是能够问出关于正在形成的图像中的视觉元素的纯文本问题并直接收到从上下文符号中解码的答案。 为此,我们培训了一个轻量级瓶颈网络,将中间背景符号投放到大语言模型(LLM)的输入空间. 由于LLM完全依靠所预测的上下文符号来回答视觉问题,瓶颈学习直接从文本侧面的表示取出模型的内部视觉语义. 在这样做的时候,我们可以用简单的文字来理解模型不断演变的遗传意图,揭示它如何在内部解决在生成过程中所指定的不足的即时属性。

blocks.en:
Through our reading mechanism, we find that contextual tokens encode generation-specific semantics surprisingly early in denoising. Remarkably, this remains true even when no prompt is fed into the model, showing that the tokens can acquire substantial information from the evolving visual representation alone. Figure 1 demonstrates this setting: despite the MM-DiT receiving an empty prompt, the reader can identify the person’s activity at an early denoising stage, before it can be readily inferred from the visual prediction.
Moreover, we find that readability continues to increase over the course of denoising, with the reader recovering progressively finer details about the emerging image. Importantly, this readability can also vary across different generations from the same prompt. Generations with clearer contextual representations tend to achieve higher human-preference scores, making contextual readability a meaningful signal of generation quality.
blocks.zh:
通过我们的读取机制,我们发现背景符号在解密的早期就惊人地编码了生成特定语义. 值得注意的是,即使没有迅速输入模型,也依然如此,表明这些标志能够仅从不断变化的视觉表现中获得大量信息。 图1说明了这种设置:尽管MM-DIT收到一空的提示,但读者可以在早期去名阶段识别此人的活动,然后从视觉预测中很容易推断出来。
此外,我们发现,在发号施令的过程中,可读性继续提高,读者正在逐渐恢复关于新形象的更详细细节。 重要的是,这种可读性也可能因不同世代而异,与同一时速不同。 具有更清晰背景表现的世代往往能达到更高的人偏好分数,使背景可读性成为产生质量的有意义的信号.

blocks.en:
Building on these observations, we transition from passively reading the contextual tokens to actively supervising them during model training.
To this end, we introduce Contextual Alignment, a regularization objective that explicitly reinforces the visual-semantic information encoded in the contextual space.
We evaluate our supervised training framework through quantitative and qualitative experiments spanning both full model training and fine-tuning. Our experiments show that contextual supervision complements existing alignment methods, improving generation quality and distributional coverage. Furthermore, while existing alignment methods provide only limited additional gains in the fine-tuning regime, contextual supervision remains highly effective when adapting an already extensively trained model to a specific dataset.
blocks.zh:
在这些意见的基础上,我们从被动阅读背景符号过渡到在示范培训期间积极监督它们。
为此,我们引入了"背景对接",这个规范化目标明确强化了被编码在上下文空间中的视觉语义信息.
我们通过涵盖全面示范培训和微调的定量和定性实验,评估我们监督的培训框架。 我们的实验表明,环境监督补充了现有的调整方法,改善了发电质量和分布范围。 此外,虽然现有的调整方法在微调制度中仅提供了有限的额外收益,但在将一个已经得到广泛培训的模型适用于特定数据集时,环境监督仍然非常有效。

blocks.en: Overall, our work establishes the contextual space as a semantically rich representation that can both expose the internal dynamics of multimodal generation and provide an effective target for improving generative models beyond the standard diffusion objective.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,我们的工作将背景空间确定为一种非常丰富的代表性,既能揭示多模式生成的内部动态,又能为超越标准传播目标而改进基因模型提供有效目标。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Diffusion models have traditionally relied on convolutional U-Net architectures as their denoising backbone ( Saharia et al., 2022 ; Ramesh et al., 2022 ; Rombach et al., 2022 ; Podell et al., 2023 ) . Transformer-based denoisers later offered a more scalable alternative ( Bao et al., 2023 ; Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) , leading to increasingly large transformer-based text-to-image models ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Chen et al., 2024a ) . Stable Diffusion 3 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) took this development further by introducing the Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT), in which textual and visual representations jointly participate in attention and continuously update one another. This bidirectional interaction has since become a prominent design in large-scale image generation and editing models, including FLUX ( Labs, 2024 ; Labs et al., 2025 ) , Qwen-Image ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) , and others ( Zhuo et al., 2024 ; Cai et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 扩散模型传统上以革命型的U-Net建筑为主干(Saharia等,2022;Ramesh等,2022;Rombach等,2022;Podel等,2023)。 以变压器为基础的变压器后来提供了更可伸缩的替代品(Bao等,2023;Peebles和Xie,2023),导致变压器的文本到图像模型越来越大(Chen等,2024b; 陈等, 2024a.). Stable Divusion 3 (Esser等,2024年)通过引入多式Difusion Transformer(MM-DIT)来进一步推进了这一发展,其中文字和视觉表述共同参与关注,并不断相互更新. 这种双向交互自此成为了大型图像生成和编辑模型中的突出设计,包括FLUX(Labs,2024;Labs等,2025;Quen-Image(Wu等,2025;Zhao等,2026;)等(Zhuo等,2024;Cai等,2025;Xiao等,2025).

blocks.en: The same paradigm has become important in video generation, where CogVideoX ( Yang et al., 2025 ) and HunyuanVideo ( Kong et al., 2024 ) jointly process textual and spatiotemporal representations. Other models extend joint attention to appearance and motion ( Chefer et al., 2025 ) or audio and video ( Wang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Shan et al., 2025 ) . Together, these developments establish joint multimodal attention as a general mechanism for evolving representations across modalities.
blocks.zh: 同样的范式在视频生成中也变得重要了,CogVideoX(Yang等,2025年)和HunyuanVideo(Kong等,2024年)共同处理文本和spatiopal表示. 其他型号对外观和运动(Chefer等,2025年)或音频和视频(Wang等,2026b; Wang等,2025; Shan等,2025.). 这些发展共同确立了对多式联运的共同关注,作为不同模式代表不断演变的一般机制。

blocks.en: A growing body of work has investigated the internal representations learned by diffusion models. Studies of visual features have shown that intermediate representations encode the semantics of individual patches and the correspondence between them, enabling a range of downstream applications ( Tumanyan et al., 2023 ; Tang et al., 2023 ; Patashnik et al., 2023 ; Cao et al., 2023 ; Alaluf et al., 2024 ; Dahary et al., 2024 ; Dahary et al., 2025 ; Sella et al., 2025 ; Luo et al., 2024 ) . Other studies examine textual representations in text-to-image models, studying how semantic information is encoded and distributed across textual tokens ( Rassin et al., 2022 ; Toker et al., 2024 ; Kaplan et al., 2026 ; Zhuang et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 越来越多的工作调查了通过传播模式获得的内部表现。 对视觉特征的研究表明,中间代表编码了单个补丁的语义及其之间的对应,使得一系列下游应用成为可能(Tumanyan等,2023;Tang等,2023;Patashnik等,2023;Cao等,2023;Alaluf等,2024;Dahary等,2024;Dahary等,2025;Sella等,2025;Luo等,2024)。 其他研究考察了文本到图像模型中的文字表述,研究语义信息如何被编码并跨文本符号分布(Rassin等,2022;Toker等,2024;Kaplan等,2026;Zhuang等,2024).

blocks.en: With the emergence of MM-DiTs, recent work has also begun to examine the evolving text-side representations formed through multimodal attention. ConceptAttention ( Helbling et al., 2025 ) uses these representations to localize concepts in the generated image, while Contextual Repulsion ( Dahary et al., 2026 ) demonstrates their utility as an intervention space for increasing generation diversity. Several works use causal interventions to reveal functional roles of contextual tokens under specific conditioning settings. Padding Tone ( Toker et al., 2025 ) shows that, under textual conditioning, contextualized padding tokens can contribute additional visual information to the generated image; Vision-Language Binding ( Ge et al., 2026 ) shows that contextual tokens can acquire semantic information from a reference image in FLUX.2 editing; Li et al. ( Li et al., 2026 ) show that LLM-encoded template tokens in Qwen-Image can act as implicit registers for maintaining object identity. Altogether, these interventions demonstrate that contextual tokens can carry information relevant to generation. However, they do not directly reveal the semantic content of the contextual space or how it evolves over denoising. We instead decode this space into natural language, revealing a surprisingly broad range of image-specific semantics encoded within it. Remarkably, this information can be decoded in the absence of textual conditioning and even before it becomes readily apparent in the visual prediction itself.
blocks.zh: 随着MM-DiTs的出现,最近的工作也已开始审查通过多模式关注形成的不断变化的文本侧面表述。 概念注意(Helbling等,2025年)利用这些表述将生成的图像中的概念本地化,而上下文回放(Dahary等,2026年)则显示出它们作为增加生成多样性的干预空间的效用. 一些作品利用因果干预揭示了特定条件环境下背景符号的功能作用. Padding Tone(Toker等,2025年)表明,在文字调理下,上下文化的活字符号可以为生成的图像提供额外的视觉信息; Vision-Language Binding(Ge等,2026年)显示上下文活字符号可以从FLUX.2编辑中的参考图像中获取语义信息;Li等. (Li等,2026年)显示,Quen-Image中的LLM-encoded模板符可以作为隐含的登记册来维护对象身份. 总之,这些干预措施表明,背景标志可以传递与生成有关的信息。 然而,它们并没有直接揭示上下文空间的语义内容,或者它是如何演变而超越去名化的. 我们将这个空间解码为自然语言, 揭示出一个令人惊讶的广泛 图像特定的语义 编码在其中。 值得注意的是,这种信息可以在没有文字条件的情况下被解码,甚至在视觉预测本身中很容易地显现出来之前.

blocks.en: Recent work has shown that explicitly encouraging diffusion models to learn stronger internal representations can substantially improve both training efficiency and generation quality. REPA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) introduced this direction by aligning intermediate visual features with representations from a pretrained vision encoder. Subsequent works extend alignment to attention features ( Wang et al., 2026c ) , the latent space ( Leng et al., 2025 ; Zheng et al., 2026 ) , representations derived from the diffusion model itself ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Chefer et al., 2026 ) , and text–image contrastive objectives ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . Recent analyses have also examined the role of local and global information in representation alignment. iREPA ( Singh et al., 2025 ) shows that, for spatial visual features, alignment benefits primarily from preserving and enhancing spatial structure rather than global semantics. REG ( Wu et al., 2026 ) instead shows that global semantic information can benefit class-conditional generation when represented separately through a high-level semantic token alongside the image latents.
blocks.zh: 最近的工作表明,明确鼓励推广模式来学习更强有力的内部表现,可以大大提高培训效率和生成质量。 REPA(Yu等,2024年)引入了这个方向,将中间视觉特征与从被预先训练的视觉编码器得到的表示一致. 随后的作品扩展了关注特征(Wang等,2026c),潜在空间(Leng等,2025;Zheng等,2026),传播模型本身衍生的表达(Jiang等,2025;Chefer等,2026),和文本-图像对比目标(Lee等,2026). 最近的分析还审查了地方和全球信息在协调代表性方面的作用。 iREPA(Singh等人,2025年)表明,对于空间视觉特征而言,对接主要得益于保护和加强空间结构,而不是全球语义。 REG(Wu等,2026年)相反地表明,全球语义信息如果通过高级语义符号和图像潜伏物分别表示,则有利于类条件生成。

blocks.en: We extend these insights to text-conditioned generation and find that global visual semantics are implicitly encoded in the contextual tokens. We therefore align them with a global semantic representation, complementing the local, spatial representations reinforced by existing alignment methods.
blocks.zh: 我们把这些洞察力扩展到文字条件的生成,发现全球视觉语义在上下文符号中含蓄地被编码. 因此,我们使其与全球语义表述相一致,补充了现有调整方法所强化的地方和空间表述。

blocks.en: 3 Reading the Contextual Space
blocks.zh: 3个 读取背景空间

blocks.en:
We introduce the Contextual Reader , a framework for decoding the internal contextual representations of Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) into natural language. We formulate this as a visual question answering task.
At a selected timestep during generation, the reader receives the contextual representations produced by all MM-DiT layers together with a question about the emerging image.
The question can probe the image at different levels of detail, including properties that are not explicitly specified by the prompt. The reader then generates a textual answer using the contextual representation and the question. This allows us to examine which visual semantics are encoded in the contextual space as generation progresses.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了背景阅读器(Contentual Reader),这是将多模式分解变形器(MM-DITs)的内部背景表现解码为自然语言的框架. 我们将此作为视觉问题回答的任务。
在一代人中选定的一个时间步上,读者会收到所有MM-DIT层制作的上下文表述,以及一个有关正在出现的图像的问题.
这个问题可以在不同的详细级别来探究图像,包括没有被快取明确指定的属性. 读者然后利用背景表述和问题生成文字解答. 这使得我们能够研究随着代代的进步,哪个视觉语义在上下文空间被编码.

blocks.en: 3.1 Reader Architecture
blocks.zh: 3.1 读者建筑

blocks.en: Figure 2: Training the Contextual Reader. At a selected denoising timestep, contextual tokens from multiple frozen MM-DiT layers are aggregated by a trainable Bottleneck Network into a compact Contextual Descriptor. A frozen LLM receives this descriptor together with a visual question and predicts an answer about the emerging image. We train only the Bottleneck Network using cross-entropy against the ground-truth answer.
blocks.zh: 图2:培训背景读者。 在选定的去名时间步上,来自多层被冻结的MM-DIT层的上下文符号被可被可训练的Bottleneck Network集成为紧凑的上下文描述符. 被冷冻的LLM会收到这个描述符连同一个视觉问题,并预言对正在出现的图像的答案. 我们只训练Bottleneck网络 使用交叉进取与地面真实的答案。

blocks.en:
Figure 2 illustrates the architecture and training procedure of our Contextual Reader.
The reader has two main components.
First, a Bottleneck Network aggregates contextual tokens from multiple MM-DiT layers into a small set of tokens, which we call the Contextual Descriptor . Second, a frozen LLM receives this descriptor together with the visual question and generates the final answer.
blocks.zh:
图2显示了我国背景阅读器的结构和培训程序。
读者主要有两部分.
首先,一个Bottleneck Network将多个 MM-DIT 层的上下文符号集成到一组小的符号中,我们称之为"上下文描述". 第二,被冻结的LLM与视觉问题一起收到这个描述符并生成最终答案.

blocks.en:

blocks.en: 3.2 Training the Contextual Reader
blocks.zh: 3.2 培训背景读者

blocks.en: The Contextual Reader is trained to decode semantic properties of the corresponding final image from contextual representations at arbitrary denoising timesteps. Each training sample therefore consists of a contextual representation, a visual question, and a target answer for the corresponding generated image. We construct this supervision directly from the MM-DiT generation process.
blocks.zh: "背景阅读器"在任意解密时间步时从背景表达中解码相应最终图像的语义属性. 因此,每个培训样本包括一个背景说明、一个视觉问题和相应的生成图像的目标答案。 我们直接从MM-DIT生成过程构建这种监督.

blocks.en: To define a consistent set of questions that are meaningful across generations, we focus on images containing a single human subject. We curate 15 questions spanning broad scene properties, such as camera angle and background, as well as finer-grained properties, such as pose, appearance, and object interaction.
blocks.zh: 为了定义一套连续世代有意义的问题,我们侧重于包含一个单一人类主题的图像。 我们研究15个问题, 涉及广泛的场景属性, 如相机角度和背景, 以及更细细的属性, 如姿势、外观和物体相互作用。

blocks.en: To generate the images, we use a subset of human-centric, single-subject prompts from MS-COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) . To encourage the reader to distinguish between different outcomes under the same textual conditioning, we generate five seeds for each prompt. Our dataset comprises 10,000 generations from 2,000 training prompts and 2,500 held-out generations from 500 prompts. For each generated image, an off-the-shelf Vision-Language Model provides answers to the 15 questions, which serve as the target supervision for the reader. For each generated image, we also store the prompt and initial noise used for generation, allowing us to retrieve its contextual representations at arbitrary denoising timesteps during training. The full list of questions and additional dataset construction details are provided in Appendix A.1.3 .
blocks.zh: 为了生成图像,我们使用了MS-CO的以人为中心的单一主题提示的子集(Lin等,2014年)。 为了鼓励读者在相同的文字条件下区分不同的结果,我们为每个快取产生五个种子. 我们的数据集包括2 000个培训提示的一万代人和500个提示的2 500个被搁置的一代人。 对于每个生成的图像,一个现成的Vision-Language模型为15个问题提供了答案,这15个问题成为读者的目标监督. 对于每个生成的图像,我们还存储了一代人所用的即时和初始噪音,使我们能够在训练期间任意去名时间步回取其背景表述. 完整的问题清单和补充数据集构建细节见附录A.1.3。

blocks.en:
During reader training, we sample a denoising timestep and a generated image from our dataset, together with its associated questions and answers. Using the stored prompt and initial noise, we reconstruct the noisy latent at the sampled timestep and run the frozen MM-DiT to obtain the contextual representations C ⁡ ( t ) C(t) . The reader then produces answers to the corresponding visual questions, which are supervised against the ground-truth answers using an autoregressive cross-entropy loss.
We optimize only the Bottleneck Network, with all other components kept frozen. We train the Reader for 5,000 iterations with a batch size of 256; the validation loss decreases steeply during the first 2,000 iterations, with only modest improvements thereafter. Training details and validation curves are provided in Appendix A.1.4 .

blocks.en: Having established a mechanism for reading the contextual tokens, we now examine what this representation reveals about the emerging generation. We study this across two pretrained MM-DiTs with different architectures: SD3.5 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) , which maintains separate image and text streams while allowing them to exchange information through multimodal attention, and FLUX.2 ( Chefer et al., 2026 ) , which additionally includes single-stream blocks that jointly process the concatenated image and text tokens.
blocks.zh: 在建立了阅读背景标志的机制后,我们现在审查这一表述揭示了新一代的情况。 我们研究了两个具有不同架构的预先训练过的MM-DiT:SD3.5(Esser等,2024年),它保持了单独的图像和文本流,同时允许它们通过多模式关注来交换信息;FLUX.2(Cefer等,2026年),它还包括了单流块来联合处理被调和的图像和文本符号.

blocks.en: To study how access to the prompt affects what can be decoded from the contextual space, we consider two conditioning settings. In one, the MM-DiT receives the original prompt ( conditional setting ), allowing us to study how the contextual tokens become enriched with image-specific information beyond what the prompt specifies. In the other, the MM-DiT receives an empty prompt ( unconditional setting ), allowing us to examine how much image-specific information can be recovered without access to the prompt.
blocks.zh: 为了研究对即时器的访问如何影响可从上下文空间解码的内容,我们考虑两个条件设置. 在一个中,MM-DIT接收了原始的快取(条件设置),让我们可以研究如何在快取指定以外的图像特定信息中丰富背景符号. 另一方面,MM-DIT得到一个空的快取(无条件设置),让我们可以检查在不访问快取的情况下可以找到多少图像特定信息.

We next quantify the behavior observed qualitatively in Figures 3 and 4 . At each timestep, we use VLM-as-a-judge ( Lee et al., 2024 ) to compare the reader’s free-form answer with the ground-truth answer and assess its semantic correctness and specificity (see Appendix A.1.5 for details and Appendices B.1.1 and B.1.2 for additional quantitative analyses). The left panel of Figure 5 shows a consistent trend across both architectures. With the input prompt, the contextual representation is informative from the beginning of generation, but its readability continues to increase throughout denoising, reaching its highest value at 80 % 80\% . Since some questions can already be partially answered from the prompt, this continued improvement indicates that the contextual tokens progressively capture attributes left underspecified by the textual conditioning.
Readability then shows a small decrease at the final 100 % 100\% timestep, as generation shifts toward refining high-frequency details rather than the semantic properties probed by our questions.

The middle and right panels of Figure 5 address this relationship.
For each prompt, we first rank the five generations according to their reader score averaged across denoising timesteps. We then compare the HPS scores ( Ma et al., 2025 ) of the top- and bottom-ranked generations.
The middle panel reports Δ \Delta HPS, defined as the HPS score of the reader top-ranked generation minus that of the bottom-ranked generation. This indicates that contextual readability provides a meaningful signal for identifying higher-quality final generations. We therefore turn, in the next section, to explicitly supervising the visual-semantic information encoded in the contextual tokens.

blocks.en: 4 Supervising the Contextual Space
blocks.zh: 4 监督背景空间

blocks.en:
The previous section reveals that contextual tokens encode rich, global visual-semantic information about the emerging image, and that the clarity of this information is related to the quality of the resulting generation. We therefore seek to make this implicit semantic structure an explicit training signal. Representation alignment provides a natural mechanism for doing so: a pretrained vision encoder provides a target representation, and the diffusion model is trained to align its intermediate visual features with this target ( Yu et al., 2024 ; Chefer et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026c ) . These methods primarily align spatial visual representations, and
have been shown to benefit from spatially structured teacher representations rather than global semantic ones ( Singh et al., 2025 ) . Since our analysis reveals that contextual tokens encode global visual semantics, we instead use a global semantic teacher to supervise them, providing a complementary form of representation alignment.
We therefore introduce Contextual Alignment (CoAl), which aligns contextual tokens with a global semantic representation of the corresponding clean image.
blocks.zh:
上一节揭示了上下文符号编码了丰富的,全球的视觉语义信息,关于正在出现的图像,这种信息的清晰度与生成者的质量有关. 因此,我们力求使这种隐含的语义结构成为明确的训练信号。 表示调和提供了这样做的自然机制:预先训练的视觉编码器提供了目标表示,并培训了传播模型使其中间视觉特征与这一目标相匹配(Yu等,2024;Chefer等,2026;Wang等,2026c.). 这些方法主要对应于空间视觉表现,以及
事实证明,从空间结构化的教师表述而不是全球语义表述中受益(Singh等人,2025年)。 由于我们的分析表明,背景符号是全球视觉语义的编码,因此我们使用一个全球语义老师来监督这些符号,提供一种互补的表达方式。
因此,我们引入了背景对接(CoAl),将背景符号与相应的清洁图像的全球语义表述相配合。

blocks.en: 4.1 Contextual Alignment
blocks.zh: 4.1 背景调整

blocks.en: Our training process is illustrated in Figure 6 . During training, a frozen semantic encoder maps the clean image to a global teacher embedding, and a lightweight network, the Aligner Network , maps the contextual tokens from a single layer to a predicted embedding. The embedding is then aligned with the teacher via a negative cosine similarity loss. We incorporate this loss into the diffusion objective and optimize the MM-DiT and the Aligner Network jointly; the Aligner Network is used exclusively during training, leaving the MM-DiT’s inference cost unchanged.
blocks.zh: 我们的培训过程见图6。 在培训期间,一个被冻结的语义编码器将干净的图像映射到一个全球教师嵌入,以及一个轻量级网络Aligner网络将背景符号从一个单层映射到一个预测嵌入. 嵌入后通过负同位素相似性损失与老师对接. 我们把这个损失纳入传播目标,并联合优化MM-DIT和Aligner网络;Aligner网络完全用于培训,使MM-DIT的推论费用保持不变。

blocks.en: Seeking a global, semantic, and language-aligned teacher, we use the pooled SigLIP image embedding ( Zhai et al., 2023 ) , which SigLIP trains to align with caption embeddings through a contrastive image-text loss, making it a compact summary of the image. The Aligner Network itself is a small Q-Former, as in the Contextual Reader, but kept even more minimal: a single layer with one learned query. Its limited capacity makes closing the gap to the teacher depend on adaptation of the MM-DiT, rather than on the Aligner Network absorbing the alignment objective. Likewise, by aligning a single, early layer, we encourage the MM-DiT to encode the teacher’s semantics in the contextual tokens early on, leaving the remaining layers free to refine and use them as needed. Both our choice of teacher embedding and our layer selection are confirmed empirically (Appendix B.2.1 ).
blocks.zh: 寻找一个全局,语义,语言相通的老师,我们使用集合的SigLIP图像嵌入(Zhai等,2023年),由SigLIP列车通过对比相通的图像文本丢失来与字幕嵌入一致,使其成为图像的紧凑总结. Aligner Network本身是一个小的Q-Former,如"上下文"(Contentual Reader)中,但保持了更微乎其微:一个单层,有一个学到的查询. 它的有限能力使得向教师弥补差距依赖于MM-DIT的适应,而不是由Aligner网络吸收了校正目标. 同样,我们通过调整一个单一的、早期的层次,鼓励MM-DIT在早期将老师的语义编码在背景符号中,让其余的层次可以随意地加以完善和在必要时使用。 我们的教师嵌入选择和我们的层层选择都通过经验得到确认(附录B.2.1 )。

blocks.en:
When training text-to-image diffusion models, the text prompt is occasionally dropped to support classifier-free guidance (CFG) at inference ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ) .
When the prompt is provided to the model, the alignment objective has an easy shortcut: the contextual tokens can reduce the alignment loss by leveraging information already provided by the prompt, rather than capturing image-specific semantics that the prompt leaves unspecified.
On null-condition iterations, however, the tokens are initialized from an empty prompt, closing off this shortcut, meaning any alignment must instead be drawn through interaction between the contextual and image tokens. We therefore upweight the alignment loss specifically on null-condition iterations, encouraging a flow of semantic information from the image tokens into the contextual tokens. In practice, we apply this upweighting only in the later stages of full model training, or throughout fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
当训练文本到图像传播模式时,文本提示偶尔会被删除,以支持无分级指导(CFG)推论(Ho and Salimans, 2022).
当向模型提供快取时,对接目标有一个简单的快捷方式:上下文符号可以通过利用快取已经提供的信息来减少对接损失,而不是捕捉出快取所未指明的图像特定语义.
然而,在无条件的迭代中,指使从空的提示中初始化,关闭了这个快捷键,意味着任何对接都必须通过上下文和图像指使之间的交互来进行. 因此,我们特别用无条件的迭代来增加校正损失,鼓励将语义信息从图像符号流向上下文符号。 在实践中,我们只在全面示范培训的后期或整个微调阶段才采用这种加权法。

blocks.en: 4.2 Experimental Setup and Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 实验设置和基线

blocks.en: Training a generator from random initialization is the standard protocol for evaluating alignment methods, but for many practitioners the realistic use case is to adapt a pretrained generator to a dataset that reflects what they want to generate. We therefore evaluate CoAl in two complementary regimes. First, we train a dual-stream MM-DiT from random initialization on MS-COCO 2014 ( Lin et al., 2014 ) . Second, we fine-tune SD3 ( Esser et al., 2024 ) , a pretrained dual-stream MM-DiT, on the curated subset of Fine-T2I ( Ma et al., 2026 ) , a dataset specifically designed for T2I fine-tuning that pairs professional photographs with long, detailed prompts. This tests whether contextual supervision remains effective after extensive pretraining, when adapting to a new data distribution.
blocks.zh: 从随机初始化中培训一个生成器是评价对齐方法的标准协议,但对于许多从业者来说,现实的用例是使一个预先训练的生成器适应一个反映他们想要生成的数据集. 因此,我们在两个相辅相成的制度中评价煤矿。 第一,我们从MS-COCO 2014随机初始化(Lin等,2014年)开始训练一款双流MM-DIT. 第二,微调SD3(Esser等,2024年),是一款预训双流MM-DiT,位于Fine-T2I(Ma等,2026年)被曲解子集上,是专门为T2I微调而设计的数据集,将专业相片与长而细的提示相配. 这种测试在经过广泛的预训后,在适应新的数据分布时,环境监督是否仍然有效。

blocks.en: We compare against REPA ( Yu et al., 2024 ) and its later variants, HASTE ( Wang et al., 2026c ) and SRA ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) . For full model training, we test whether CoAl complements these visual alignment methods, comparing each objective with and without CoAl. For fine-tuning, however, REPA and its variants offer no meaningful gains over the vanilla denoising objective, so we instead combine CoAl with vanilla flow matching, including REPA, HASTE, and SRA for completeness. In the main manuscript, we report FID ( Heusel et al., 2017 ) , CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , HPS ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , and DINOv2 ( Oquab et al., 2023 ) Precision and Recall ( Kynkäänniemi et al., 2019 ) . For fine-tuning, we omit CLIP and HPS. These metrics are trained on broad, general-purpose distributions of images, captions, and preferences, so they capture what users prefer on average, which need not coincide with the characteristics of a particular fine-tuning dataset. Indeed, the ground-truth photographs score below the base model on CLIP and HPS, and therefore comparing along these axes is ill-posed. We instead evaluate how well the generated images fit and cover the target distribution, using FID, KID, and DINOv2 Precision and Recall. Our full result tables, including additional metrics and baselines, are provided in Appendix B.2.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们比较了REPA(Yu等人,2024年)及其后来的变体HASTE(Wang等人,2026年c)和SRA(Jiang等人,2025年). 对于完整的模型培训,我们测试CoAl是否补充了这些视觉对接方法,将每个目标与CoAl和没有CoAl进行比较. 不过,为了进行微调,REPA及其变体对于香草去诺能目标没有产生有意义的收益,因此我们把CoAl与香草流相匹配,包括REPA、HASTE和SRA, 以求完整。 在主要手稿中,我们报告FID(Heusel等,2017年),CLIP(Radford等,2021年),HPS(Wu等,2023年),和DINOv2(Oquab等,2023年)精密与召回(Kynkäänniemi等,2019年). 为了微调,我们省略了CLIP和HPS. 这些度量衡对图像、标题和偏好的广泛通用分布进行了培训,因此它们能捕捉到用户平均偏好的内容,这些内容不需要与特定微调数据集的特征相吻合。 事实上,地面真实照片在CLIP和HPS上低于基准模型,因此,沿着这些轴线进行比较的情况不佳。 相反,我们利用FID、KID和DINOv2精准度和召回,评估生成的图像如何适合并覆盖目标分布。 附录B.2.2提供我们的全部结果表,包括额外的衡量尺度和基线。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en: We have presented a framework for reading the internal perceptual representations of generative models through natural language. More broadly, our work suggests that a generative model knows surprisingly early what it is going to generate. Semantic details of the final image are already present internally before they become perceptually apparent in the emerging image. Even more strikingly, this remains true without the text prompt: the model develops a rich semantic picture of the emerging image through the generation process itself. This observation also has a useful consequence: generations in which this internal representation is clearer tend to result in better images. This suggests that the representation is not only something we can read, but also something worth strengthening. Our Contextual Alignment does exactly this, leading to improved generations.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个框架,用以通过自然语言来解读基因模型的内部概念表述。 更广泛地说,我们的工作表明,一个基因模型很早就知道它将产生什么。 最终图像的语义细节已经在内部呈现出,然后才在正在形成的图像中被感知地显现出. 更出人意料的是,如果没有文字的提示,这一点仍然是真实的:模型通过生成过程本身,对正在形成的图像发展出丰富的语义图. 这一观察也产生了有益的后果:这种内部代表性更加明确的几代人往往会产生更好的形象. 这表明,这种代表性不仅是我们能够读到的东西,而且值得加强。 我们的环境协调就是这样做的,导致代代相传。

blocks.en: Our findings also highlight how much remains to be understood about the internal process of generative models. We can now read some of the semantic information that emerges during generation, but how these internal representations form, evolve, and ultimately shape the generated image remains largely unexplored. The fact that meaningful information appears so early, even before it becomes perceptually apparent, raises many new questions about the generation process itself. We believe that further studying these internal representations can deepen our understanding of generative models and reveal new opportunities for controlling and improving them.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究结果还突出表明,对于遗传模型的内部过程,还有多少事情有待了解。 我们现在可以读取一些在一代人时期出现的语义信息,但这些内部代表如何形成,演化,并最终塑造所生成的图像,基本上仍未被探索. 有意义的信息看起来如此之早,甚至在它从概念上看变得明显之前,对生成过程本身提出了许多新的问题。 我们认为,进一步研究这些内部表述可以加深我们对基因模型的理解并揭示控制和改进这些模型的新机会。

blocks.en: A.1 Contextual Reader
blocks.zh: A.1 背景阅读器

blocks.en: A.1.1 Contextual Feature Extraction and Encoding
blocks.zh: A.1.1 背景特征提取和编码

blocks.en: We extract contextual representations from the attention operator of the frozen MM-DiT at the selected diffusion timestep. Specifically, we extract the output of the attention operator before the subsequent block-specific attention gate, residual addition, normalization, or MLP update. We retain only the contextual/text positions and exclude image-token positions.
blocks.zh: 我们从被冻结的MM-DIT的注意操作员那里提取到特定扩散时间段的背景说明。 具体地说,我们从注意操作器的输出中提取到后续的块特定注意门,剩余添加,正常化,或MLP更新. 我们只保留背景/文本位置,排除了图像存储位置。

blocks.en: For SD3.5, we capture the text-side output of joint attention from all transformer blocks. For FLUX.2, we capture the text-side output from all dual-stream blocks and the text positions from all single-stream blocks.
blocks.zh: 对于SD3.5,我们从所有变压器块中捕获到联合注意的文本侧输出. 对于FLUX.2,我们捕捉所有双流块的文本侧输出,以及所有单流块的文本位置.

blocks.en: For the conditional reader, we use the contextual representations produced by the positive-prompt branch. For the unconditional reader, we use the model’s empty-prompt setting. No image tokens are supplied to the reader.
blocks.zh: 对于有条件的读者,我们使用正时分行产生的上下文表述. 对于无条件的读者,我们使用模型的空即时设置. 不向读者提供图像符号 。

blocks.en: Because the reader aggregates contextual representations from multiple MM-DiT layers, we add a learned layer embedding to the contextual tokens from each layer before concatenating them. We also provide the denoising timestep to the reader. The continuous noise level σ \sigma is encoded using a 256-dimensional sinusoidal embedding followed by an MLP with dimensions 256 → 256 → D 256\rightarrow 256\rightarrow D and SiLU activation, where D D is the hidden dimension of the corresponding diffusion backbone. The resulting timestep embedding is added to every contextual token. We do not average or otherwise mix the representations across layers before the Q-Former; all layer-token pairs remain independently accessible.
blocks.zh: 因为读者汇总了来自多层MM-DIT的上下文表示,所以在调和前,我们从每层的上下文符号中加入一个已学习到的上下文表示. 我们还向读者提供禁言时间。 连续噪声等级为:\sigma,使用256维的sinusoidal嵌入法进行编码,然后是尺寸为:256 → 256 → D 256\正方形 256\正方形 D和SiLU活化法,其中D D是相应的扩散主干线的隐藏维度. 由此产生的时间步嵌入被添加到每个上下文符号上. 在Q-Former之前,我们不平均地或以其他方式将各层的表示相混合;所有层接对仍然可以独立地使用。

blocks.en: A.1.2 Bottleneck Network and Language-Model Interface
blocks.zh: A.1.2 博特伦克网络和语言-模块接口

blocks.en: The Bottleneck Network is a two-block, eight-head Q-Former with 16 learned queries. Its hidden dimension matches that of the corresponding diffusion backbone. Each Q-Former block uses a cross-first ordering. The learned queries first attend to all contextual tokens through pre-normalized cross-attention, followed by a residual connection. This is followed by pre-normalized self-attention among the queries and a residual connection, and then a pre-normalized feed-forward network with dimensions D → 2048 → D D\rightarrow 2048\rightarrow D , GELU activation, and a residual connection. A final layer normalization is applied after the second block. No dropout is used.
blocks.zh: Bottleneck Network是一款两块八头的Q-Former,有16个学习的查询. 它的隐藏维度与相应的传播主干部分相匹配. 每个Q-Former区块都使用交叉第一订单. 所学到的询问首先通过预先正常的交叉注意处理所有背景符号,然后是剩余连接. 随后,在查询中进行预先正常的自我注意,并进行剩余连接,然后建立一个预先正常的、带有D-维度的进取信息网络。 2048 ~ D\ 右后卫 2048\ 右后卫 D, GELU活化,并有剩余连接. 第二块之后将实行最后一层正常化。 不使用退学。

blocks.en: The Q-Former outputs are mapped individually into the input embedding space of the frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2025 ) language model using a learned affine projection. Each projected token is L2-normalized and rescaled to the mean norm of the LLM’s vocabulary embeddings, excluding the padding token.
blocks.zh: Q-前输出被单独地映射到被冻结的Quen2.5-7B-Instruct(Quen等,2025年)语言模型的输入嵌入空间中,使用一个有学识的affine预测. 每个被预测的令牌被L2-正态化并被调整到LLM词汇嵌入的平均值上,不包括贴花令牌.

blocks.en: The resulting Contextual Descriptor is provided to the LLM as a sequence of 16 continuous prefix embeddings, followed by the textual question and its answer-format instruction. The original generation prompt is not provided to the LLM.
blocks.zh: 由此产生的上下文描述器作为由16个连续前缀嵌入的序列提供给LLM,再由文字问题及其答案格式指导. 最初的生成提示不提供给LLM.

blocks.en: During teacher-forced training, the target consists of the ground-truth answer and the tokenizer EOS token. The cross-entropy loss is computed only over answer tokens.
blocks.zh: 在师资强化培训期间,目标包括地面真相回答和象征性的EOS标志。 反向损失只通过答录符计算。

blocks.en: A.1.3 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: A.1.3 数据集建设

blocks.en: We construct the dataset for training and evaluating the Contextual Reader from the 2014 MS-COCO training split. We first restrict the source images to those containing exactly one non-crowd person instance according to the COCO instance annotations. We then filter the associated captions based on their textual content: each caption is classified by the text-only model Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct ( Qwen et al., 2025 ) as describing either zero, one, multiple, or an ambiguous number of real people. We retain captions classified as describing exactly one real person without ambiguity. This procedure produces 62,069 eligible captions.
blocks.zh: 我们从2014年MS-COCO培训分期构建用于培训和评价背景阅读器的数据集。 根据COCO案例说明,我们首先将原始图像限制在包含一个非人群案例的图像。 然后,我们根据文本内容过滤相关标题:每个标题被仅文本模式Quen2.5-7B-Instruct(Quen等,2025年)归类为描述0,1,多,或模糊的真实人数. 我们保留了分类为 准确描述一个真实的人 没有歧义。 这一程序产生了62,069个符合条件的标题.

blocks.en: From these captions, we select 2,500 prompts from distinct COCO source images using deterministic stratified sampling. We first select 500 prompts for the held-out set and then select 2,000 prompts from the remaining images, ensuring no source-image overlap between the two sets. Each prompt is rendered with five randomly assigned seeds, such that no seed is shared between prompts. This results in 10,000 training generations and 2,500 held-out generations per diffusion backbone.
blocks.zh: 从这些标题中,我们通过确定分层取样,从COCO不同的源图像中选择了2,500个提示。 我们首先为被搁置的设定选择了500个提示,然后从所剩图像中选择了2000个提示,确保两组之间没有源图像重叠. 每个快件由5个随机指定的种子来提供,因此快件之间没有共享种子. 其结果是,每支推广骨干有1万名培训一代和2 500名被保留一代。

blocks.en: We generate images at 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 resolution. SD3.5 uses 28 FlowMatch Euler denoising steps and guidance scale 7.0, while FLUX.2 uses 50 FlowMatch Euler steps and guidance scale 4.0. The same prompt-to-seed mapping is used for both backbones.
blocks.zh: 我们以1024×1024 1024\时间1024分辨率生成图像. SD3.5采用28 FlowMatch Euler去诺化步骤和制导尺度7.0,而FLUX.2则采用50 FlowMatch Euler步骤和制导尺度4.0. 同样的即时到种子映射用于两个骨干.

blocks.en: We train a separate reader for each diffusion backbone and conditioning setting. The diffusion backbone, text encoders, VAE, and LLM remain frozen throughout training. Only the Q-Former and the projection layer are optimized.

At each training iteration, we sample a continuous noise level σ ∼ U ⁡ [ 0 , 1 ] \sigma\sim U[0,1] ,

blocks.en: We evaluate the reader’s predictions using a VLM-as-a-judge. We use Prometheus-Vision 13B ( Lee et al., 2024 ) to compare each reader prediction with the corresponding reference answer produced by InternVL3-8B. The judge receives the visual question, the reader’s prediction, the reference answer, and the final generated image. The generation prompt is not provided to the judge. The exact evaluation prompt and scoring rubric are shown in Figure 10 .
blocks.zh: 我们用一个作为法官的VLM来评价读者的预测。 我们使用"Prometheus-Vision"13B(Lee等,2024年)来将每个读者预测与InternVL3-8B制作的相应参考答案进行比较. 法官接收视觉问题,读者的预测,参考答案,以及最终生成的图像. 不向法官提供生成提示。 图10显示准确的评价即时和评分分分号。

blocks.en: The judge assigns an integer score from 1 to 5 based on semantic correctness, completeness, and consistency with the image. A score of 5 indicates a semantically equivalent, fully correct, and image-consistent answer, while lower scores reflect increasing degrees of incorrectness, omission, ambiguity, or contradiction. Empty predictions receive a score of 1, and all other predictions are evaluated by Prometheus-Vision. The resulting scores are normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] .
blocks.zh: 裁判根据语义正确性,完整性,与图像的一致性,将整数分从1分到5分. 5分的分数表示一个完全等同的,完全正确的,和图像相符合的答案,而较低的分数则反映不正确,遗漏,模棱两可,或自相矛盾程度不断提高. 空出预测得到1分,所有其他预测都由Prometheus-Vision评价. 所得分数常为 [0, 1] [0, 1].

blocks.en: A.2.1 Feature Extraction and Aligner Network Architecture
blocks.zh: A.2.1 采掘地物和Aligner网络结构

blocks.en: Across architectures, contextual features are extracted in the same manner as in the Contextual Reader (Appendix A.1.1 ): tokens from the contextual indices are pooled immediately after the shared attention block. Unlike the Reader, however, in CoAl we extract only the contextual features from a single MM-DiT layer l l ( l = 4 l=4 by default) and no positional embedding is added to it.
blocks.zh: 在整个架构中,背景特征的提取方式与背景阅读器(Appendix A.1.1)相同:背景指数的符号在共享关注块后立即集合. 然而,与"读取器"不同的是,在CoAl中,我们只从一个单一的MM-DIT地层l (l = 4 l = 4 默认)中取出上下文的特性,并且其中没有添加位置嵌入.

blocks.en: The Aligner network is made up of a Q-Former followed by a small MLP. The Q-Former is 24 24 head single-layer, single-query Q-Former which attends to the contextual features via pre-normalized cross-attention between the learnable query and the features. The MLP is made up of two linear layers and SiLU activation such that the dimension of the vector produced by the Q-Former is D → 1024 → d y D\rightarrow 1024\rightarrow d_{y} . With D D being the hidden dimension of the contextual tokens ( 768 768 in the MM-DiT used in the full model training setting, 1536 1536 in the SD3-Medium model used in the fine-tune setting). As explained in the main paper, the Aligner network, along with the MM-DiT, are optimized via a negative cosine similarity loss between the Aligner Network output and the teacher embedding.

blocks.en: In the full model training setting the MM-DiT architecture we train is based on the Stable Diffusion 3 model ( Esser et al., 2024 ) , but is trained entirely from scratch (no pretrained weights) at a reduced scale: 24 24 transformer layers, matching SD3’s own depth, with a hidden dimension of 768 768 and 24 24 attention heads (32-dimensional per head), compared to SD3-Medium’s 1536 1536 -dimensional hidden size at the same head count (64-dimensional per head). Training data is MS-COCO 2014 ( Lin et al., 2014 ) , downloaded from this source , using the official train2014 / val2014 split ( 82,783 / 40,504 82{,}783/40{,}504 images, each with ∼ \sim 5 captions), at 256 × 256 256\times 256 resolution. We use the AdamW optimizer with a constant learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} , no weight decay, and ϵ = 1 × 10 − 8 \epsilon=1\times 10^{-8} , with a global batch size of 256 256 . We maintain an exponential moving average (EMA) of the model weights with decay 0.9999 0.9999 , initialized as an exact copy of the model at step 0, and report all results using the EMA weights. We train for 150,000 150{,}000 iterations using fp16 mixed precision. Using 8 NVIDIA B200 GPUs training takes approximately 12.5 12.5 hours.

blocks.en:
We compare the semantic readability of the contextual space with that of the latent and the prompt. We follow the evaluation protocol described in Appendix A.1.5 and consider two complementary questions:
whether contextual tokens provide semantic information beyond what is recoverable from the latent at early denoising stages,
and whether they encode information beyond what can be inferred from the textual conditioning alone.

语义符号是否提供语义信息,超出从早期去意阶段的潜在信息中可以恢复的信息,

blocks.en: We first compare the contextual space with two alternative sources of information. First, we train a Latent Reader using the same LLM and reader architecture as the Contextual Reader, but provide it with the output latent representation at the corresponding denoising timestep instead of contextual tokens. Second, we use InternVL3-8B to answer the visual question from the predicted clean image at each timestep; we refer to this baseline as x 0 x_{0} +VLM. We note that the ground-truth answers used for evaluation are also generated by InternVL3-8B from the final images, making x 0 x_{0} +VLM more closely aligned with the evaluation target.
blocks.zh: 我们首先将背景空间与两个替代性信息来源进行比较。 首先,我们使用与背景阅读器相同的LLM和阅读器架构来训练Latet Reader,但在相应的去名时间步而不是上下文符号上为它提供输出的潜在表现. 第二,我们使用InternVL3-8B从每个时段的预测的清洁图像中解答视觉问题;我们把这个基线称为x0 x_{0}+VLM. 我们注意到,用于评价的地面真实答案也是由InternVL3-8B从最后图像中生成的,使xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx +VLM更紧密地与评价目标相配合.

blocks.en: Figure 11 shows the resulting readability scores for both diffusion backbones. The conditional Contextual Reader consistently outperforms the Latent Reader throughout denoising, while the unconditional Contextual Reader outperforms the Latent Reader from 10 % 10\% onward despite having no access to the textual conditioning. In comparison, x 0 x_{0} +VLM achieves the highest readability from approximately 40 % 40\% onward. Remarkably, before this point, both the conditional and unconditional Contextual Readers achieve higher readability despite having no direct access to the image. These results show that contextual tokens provide a particularly informative representation of semantic information during the early stages of denoising.

blocks.en: We next examine how much of the semantic information decoded by the Contextual Reader can be attributed to the information available from the textual conditioning and the LLM’s prior alone. To this end, we train a Prompt Reader using the same LLM and reader architecture as the Contextual Reader, but provide it only with the input prompt rather than contextual tokens. The Prompt Reader is trained with the same visual questions and target answers as the Contextual Reader.
blocks.zh: 接下来,我们审视一下,由背景阅读器解码的语义信息有多少可以归结于文本条件和LLM先前的信息。 为此,我们使用与上下文阅读器相同的LLM和阅读器架构来培训一个即时阅读器,但只提供输入即时而非上下文的符号. 即时阅读器接受与上下文阅读器相同的视觉问答和目标回答训练.

blocks.en: Figure 12 compares the resulting readability scores for both diffusion backbones and conditioning settings. The Prompt Reader achieves constant readability throughout denoising, as expected since its input prompt remains unchanged. In contrast, the conditional Contextual Reader achieves higher readability than the Prompt Reader throughout denoising, with the largest gap between 20 % 20\% and 80 % 80\% . The unconditional Contextual Reader, which receives no textual conditioning, surpasses the Prompt Reader as denoising progresses for FLUX.2 and approaches it for SD3.5. These results show that contextual tokens encode semantic information beyond what can be inferred from the textual conditioning and the LLM’s prior.
blocks.zh: 图12比较了由此产生的扩散主干和调制设置的可读性分数。 " 即时阅读器 " 在整个发音过程中都实现了可读性,这是预期的,因为其输入即时不变。 相比之下,有条件的上下文阅读器在整个发号施令过程中的可读性高于"即时阅读器",其最大差距在20%-20%-80%-80%-80%之间. 无文字条件的无条件背景阅读器在FLUX.2的发音上超过了即时阅读器,接近了SD3.5. 这些结果表明,语义符号编码语义信息超出了从文字条件和LLM前作推断的范围.

blocks.en: To evaluate whether the reader generalizes beyond the questions used during training, we perform a held-out-question evaluation. For each of the 15 questions, we train a separate reader on the remaining 14 questions and evaluate it exclusively on the held-out question. We repeat this procedure for all questions and report the average readability across the 15 held-out evaluations.

blocks.en: Figure 13 shows the resulting readability scores for both diffusion backbones and conditioning settings. Compared to the evaluation on questions seen during training, readability decreases, as expected, but remains meaningful. The conditional readers reach scores of approximately 0.50 0.50 , corresponding to responses that are typically judged as partially correct, with some omissions. We observe the same trend for the unconditional readers as in our earlier experiments: their readability approaches that of the conditional readers as denoising progresses. SD3.5 reaches approximately 0.40 0.40 (generally relevant but with some omissions), while FLUX.2 eventually surpasses the conditional reader later in denoising. These results show that the reader retains the ability to decode semantic information even for questions that were never observed during training.

blocks.en: B.2.1 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: B.2.1 读取研究

blocks.en: To validate our design choices, we ablate the semantic teacher, the contextual layer at which alignment is applied, and the null-condition weighting scheme, in both the full model training and fine-tuning settings (Table 2 ). Across both settings, CoAl is fairly robust to the choice of teacher, though SigLIP consistently edges out CLIP, DINOv2, and Qwen3-VL-2B. Aligning earlier contextual layers also consistently outperforms aligning later ones, likely because doing so gives more of the network the opportunity to make use of the well-aligned representation as it propagates forward. Finally, null-condition weighting proves especially important in the fine-tuning setting: since a pre-trained model already aligns reasonably well with the semantic teacher whenever the prompt is present, upweighting the loss contributes most on the text-dropped iterations, where that shortcut disappears.
blocks.zh: 为了验证我们的设计选择,我们在完整的模型培训和微调设置中,都放弃了语义老师、应用对齐的背景层和无条件加权方案(表2)。 在两种情况下,CoAl在选择教师方面都相当强健,尽管SigLIP始终领先于CLIP,DINOv2和Qune3-VL-2B. 调整先前的上下文层也一直比调整后各层的业绩要好,因为这样做可能使更多的网络有机会在传播时利用协调良好的代表。 最后,无条件加权在微调设置中证明特别重要:由于预先训练的模型在提示出现时已经与语义老师相当吻合,因此,增加加权损失在文本投放的重迭中贡献最大,因为该快捷键在其中消失。

blocks.en: In addition to the results in the main paper, we provide an extended quantitative comparison for both the full model training and fine-tuning settings (Tables 3 and 4 ), reporting VQAScore ( Lin et al., 2024 ) and KID ( Bińkowski et al., 2018 ) alongside the metrics used in the main paper. KID can be more informative than FID on smaller evaluation sets, which is relevant here since the Fine-T2I validation set contains only 5k images. We also add REG ( Wu et al., 2026 ) as an additional baseline in both settings. Similar to CoAl, it supervises a global semantic representation of the image rather than local, patch-level structure, which made it a natural point of comparison. However, it is designed for class-conditional architectures with no text branch, and it does not seem to translate well to MM-DiT, which already carries this kind of information through a fully functional contextual branch. Its FID and KID both come out worse than plain diffusion training. We therefore do not include it in the main manuscript or test it in combination with CoAl. For fine-tuning, we also report Reference and Base Model rows, where Reference denotes the real Fine-T2I validation images and Base Model is the pretrained SD3-Medium checkpoint before fine-tuning. For every configuration combined with CoAl, we report both how it compares to its own non-CoAl counterpart, colored green where it improves and red where it regresses, with the percent change alongside it, and how it ranks against every other configuration in the table, with bold/underline marking the best/second-best per column.
blocks.zh: 除主要论文中的结果外,我们还对完整的模型培训和微调设置(表3和表4),报告VQAScore(Lin等,2024年)和KID(Binkowski等,2018年),以及主要论文中使用的度量衡进行了广泛的定量比较。 KID比FID更能提供小评价集的信息,因为Fine-T2I验证集只包含5克图像,所以这里相关. 我们还增加了REG(Wu等人,2026年),作为这两种环境的补充基线。 与CoAl类似,它监督图像的全球语义表现,而不是局部的补丁级结构,这使得它成为一个自然的比较点. 然而,它是为没有文本分支的类条件建筑而设计的,它似乎没有很好地翻译为MM-DIT,它已经通过一个功能完备的上下文分支携带了这种信息. 它的FID和KID都比普通的传播训练更糟糕。 因此,我们不将其列入主要手稿,也不与CoAl结合测试。 对于微调,我们还报告参考和基础模型行,其中参考表示真实的Fine-T2I验证图像,而基础模型在微调前是预先训练的SD3-中度检查站. 对于每个组合与 CoAl 组合, 我们报告它如何与自己的非 CoAl 对应方相比, 颜色绿色在它改善的地方, 红色在它倒退的地方, 百分率随同变化,

blocks.en: As already noted in the main paper for CLIP and HPS, Reference in fact scores below Base Model on all three preference and alignment style metrics in this extended comparison, including VQAScore. This reinforces that these axes should be read with caution in the fine-tuning setting: a real photograph scoring below a model’s output does not mean the model produces more faithful images, only that these metrics reward image and caption conventions particular to their own training distributions.
blocks.zh: 正如CLIP和HPS的主要论文已经指出的,在这个扩展比较中,包括VQAScore在内的所有三种偏好和对齐样式的度量标准,参照事实上都低于Base Model. 这突出表明,在微调时应谨慎地阅读这些轴:模型输出下的真实相片评分并不意味着模型产生更忠实的相片,而只是这些衡量标准奖励图像和图示惯例,特别是它们自己的培训分布。

blocks.en: In the full model training setting, the orthogonal comparison confirms the pattern from the main paper: every representation-alignment baseline improves on most metrics when combined with CoAl. Looking across the table as a whole rather than baseline by baseline, REPA + CoAl is not just the best combination relative to plain REPA, but the single best configuration overall, achieving the best value in every column we report. For fine-tuning, we additionally report REPA, HASTE, and SRA combined with CoAl for completeness. All three combinations improve KID substantially over their respective baselines (5.6 to 20.7%), and where they do decrease Precision or Recall, the drop is marginal: REPA + CoAl is the only one of the three to regress on either metric, and only by 0.0% and 0.1%, respectively.
blocks.zh: 在完整的模式培训环境中,正统比较证实了主要文件中的规律:在与CoAl结合时,每个表示-调节基线在大多数指标上都有所改进。 从整个表格来看,而不是从基线来看,REPA + CoAl 不仅仅是相对于普通REPA的最佳组合,而是总体的单一最佳配置,在我们报告的每一栏中都实现了最佳值. 为了进行微调,我们另外报告REPA、HASTE和SRA以及CoAl是否完整。 所有三种组合都比各自的基线(5.6%至20.7%)大大改进了KID,如果它们确实降低了精度或召回率,则下降幅度很小: REPA + CoAl是三个指标中唯一一个在两个指标上倒退的,并且分别只下降0.0和0.1%。

blocks.en: B.2.3 Performance Across CFG Scales
blocks.zh: B.2.3 跨CFG规模的业绩

blocks.en: Figure 19: Effect of classifier-free guidance (CFG) scale on FID and KID on the Fine-T2I curated benchmark (val5k), comparing Vanilla, REPA, HASTE, and CoAl.
blocks.zh: 图19:无分级制导(CFG)尺度对FID和KID对Fine-T2I规范基准(val5k)的影响,比较了Vanilla、REPA、HASTE和CoAl。

blocks.en: One might argue that our null-condition weighting scheme simply shifts the effective classifier-free guidance scale reached during training, and that evaluating at a different CFG value could reveal different behavior. To test this, we sweep CFG scale from 1 to 9 for Vanilla, REPA, HASTE, and Vanilla + CoAl on the Fine-T2I curated benchmark (Figure 19 ). CoAl is consistently the strongest of the four across the entire sweep. CFG = 2 =2 gives the best FID and KID for every method, ourselves included. We nonetheless use CFG = 7 =7 for all evaluations and generations elsewhere in the paper, since it offers a better balance between prompt adherence and distributional fidelity. Recent work ties image quality under classifier-free guidance to how closely the conditional and unconditional predictions agree with each other over the course of sampling: as the distance between them grows, the guidance direction takes large, sharp turns that can push generation off the data manifold ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Yehezkel et al., 2025 ) . CoAl handles large CFG values noticeably better than the other methods, which could suggest that its conditional and unconditional predictions agree with each other more closely. This is indeed what our null-condition weighting is designed to encourage: by encouraging the contextual branch to draw on information from the image tokens when the prompt is omitted, we in turn encourage similarity between the null and conditioned predictions, assuming the image is aligned with the prompt.
blocks.zh: 人们可能会认为,我们的无条件加权方案只是改变训练期间达到的有效无分级制指导尺度,而以不同的CFG值进行评价可能揭示出不同的行为。 为了测试这一点,我们将香草、REPA、HASTE和香草+CoAl的CFG比分从1到9扫到Fine-T2I标准(图19)。 在整个扫荡中,CoAl是四强中最强的。 CFG = 2 = 2 给出每种方法的最佳FID和KID,包括我们自己. 尽管如此,我们仍对本文其他部分的所有评价及世代使用CFG=7=7,因为它在迅速遵守和分配忠诚之间提供了更好的平衡。 最近的工作将无分级制导下的图像质量与有条件和无条件的预测在采样过程中的相互一致程度联系起来:随着它们之间的距离增大,导向会大而尖锐地转弯,可以把生成从数据多面推开(Wang等人,2026a;Yehezkel等人,2025年). CoAl处理大的CFG值明显优于其他方法,这可以表明其有条件和无条件的预测更紧密地相互一致. 这正是我们设定的无条件加权是为了鼓励:通过鼓励上下文分支在省略提示时从图像符号中取出信息,我们反过来鼓励无效预测和有条件预测之间的相似性,假设图像与提示一致.
